This package contains generic functions used frequently by myself. This
package is updated as functions are added, updated, or removed.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`AllIdentical()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/AllIdentical.md)
  : AllIdentical

- [`C_to_overkt()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/C_to_overkt.md)
  : temperature conversion functions

- [`C_to_overkt_stand()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/C_to_overkt_stand.md)
  : C_to_overkt_stand

- [`Mode()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/Mode.md) :
  calculate the mode

- [`as2()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/as2.md) :

  A more robust form of the R `as` function.

- [`author_exchange()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/author_exchange.md)
  : This function exchanges full author list formated with First and
  Middle initials and full family name. This allows the creation of bib
  entries with full author lists

- [`buffer()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/buffer.md) :
  Pads an object to a desired length, either with replicates of itself
  or another repeated object.

- [`cbind_fill()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/cbind_fill.md)
  : Combine arbitrary data types, filling in missing rows.

- [`coalesce()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/coalesce.md)
  :

  A more versatile form of the T-SQL
  [`coalesce()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/coalesce.md)
  function.

- [`convert_complete_author()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/convert_complete_author.md)
  : This function converts full author lists to person objects.

- [`count()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/count.md) :

  A more versatile form of the T-SQL
  [`count()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/count.md)
  function.

- [`create_xy()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/create_xy.md)
  : create_xy

- [`get_complete_coauthors()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/get_complete_coauthors.md)
  : This function scrapes the full coauthor list for a publication from
  Google Scholar. It is a modified version from the scholar package that
  includes a sleep option to allow a time between http requests.

- [`get_legend()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/get_legend.md)
  : get_legend: get the legend from ggplot

- [`` `%ni%` ``](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/grapes-ni-grapes.md)
  : %ni%

- [`insertRows()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/insertRows.md)
  : Inserts a matrix into another matrix.

- [`len()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/len.md) :
  Allows finding the 'length' without knowledge of dimensionality.

- [`named_group_split()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/named_group_split.md)
  : named_group_split

- [`overkt_to_C()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/overkt_to_C.md)
  : absolute temperature conversion funciton

- [`plot_webgg()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/plot_webgg.md)
  : plot_webgg

- [`rollApply()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/rollApply.md)
  : Applies a function over a rolling window on any data object.

- [`rowApply()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/rowApply.md)
  : Applies a function row-wise on any data object.

- [`rowr`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/rowr.md) :
  Row-Based Functions for R Objects

- [`rows()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/rows.md) :
  Allows row indexing without knowledge of dimensionality or class.

- [`trackdown_download()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/trackdown_download.md)
  : trackdown_download

- [`trackdown_upload()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/trackdown_upload.md)
  : trackdown_upload

- [`vectorize()`](https://jimjunker1.github.io/junkR/reference/vectorize.md)
  : Vectorize a scalar function to work on any R object.
